text:
Nora: Heads-up 18h before cut. Need to freeze GA deliverables: SLA table, docs quickstart, support rota, monitoring panels, pricing stub. Who owns?

Ethan: I can own monitoring + alert rules. Quick list: p95 latency per-route, 5xx_rate, cache_hit_rate, median token size, token-rate anomaly. Example alert: `p95 > 350ms for 5m` page ops.

Lina: Docs owner. I'll produce JS/Python quickstart, streaming reconnect sample, and a short "limitations" section. Also add a migration note for customers on the beta endpoints.

Tom: I'll draft SLA tiers and the incident runbook. Proposal: Standard 99.5% (email), Business 99.8% (4h P1), Enterprise 99.95% (2h P1 + AM). Runbook will include a fallback to smaller model variant on latency spike.

Maya: Pricing: ship GA with flat per-token + embedding unit price and an early-enterprise pilot coupon. No complex tiering at GA. Need FinOps sign-off; will sync with them.

Ethan: Also recommend synthetic smoke tests on deploy: streaming verify + token accounting. I'll add a dashboard JSON to the repo.

Nora: Scope call: drop custom quantization and advanced autoscaling from GA; mark as alpha. Everyone okay?

Lina: Ack. Docs will mark both as "alpha" and include migration checklist.

Tom: Action: I'll draft the SLA wording and add a 14-day warm-oncall plan (one dedicated responder weekdays).

Maya: I'll prepare pricing stub and link it here when ready. Need median tokens/request from eng. @Ethan please share.

Ethan: Shared a short token histogram in the channel. Median ~450 tokens, p95 ~3200.

Nora: PR merge checklist before cut: 1) SLA doc link, 2) runbook link, 3) docs quickstart link, 4) monitoring dashboard link, 5) pricing draft link. Must be green 12h before canary.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Reminder: run smoke tests and validate telemetry.

Lina: Starting docs PR now; will include code samples and errors table.

Tom: I'll add the fallback routing snippet to the runbook (how to reroute to smaller model).

Maya: Pinged FinOps; will post pricing draft EOD.

Nora: Thanks all 1 I'll send an owners recap email and tag reviewers.
